intro: Wrenix of Ratchet is a Horde rogue assignment directing aspiring agents out of Orgrimmar and down to the goblin port of Ratchet. The manic troll Zando'zan sends operatives south to assist a disreputable goblin named Wrenix the Wretched.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Zando'zan has seen it! Yes, the day comes! Thrall's death... The dagger in his back, poison seeping through to his every vein... Zando'zan has said too much.
Friend! Zando'zan has a task for friend! Friend must travel to Ratchet, east of the Crossroads, and speak with Wrenix the Wretched. Go!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Another one? The last five that crazy troll sent me ended up as shark food. Let's hope you fare a little better, eh?
